observations: Black-bodied manual/treadle sewing machine head mounted on a wooden table with cast-iron treadle base visible underneath (photo 3).
Gold scrollwork decoration on the machine arm and bed.
Brand name 'AMRO BROTHER' clearly visible on the machine arm and on a round badge on the body (photos 2 and 3).
A smaller plate reading something like 'ROWAD' or similar is visible near the needle plate (photos 2, 3) - possibly the bobbin cover or a second badge, not clearly legible.
Visible rust/oxidation spots on the metal bed plate near the needle area (photo 0, photo 1).
Wood veneer on the table top shows wear, scratches, and discoloration at the edges (all photos).
Treadle pedal and iron frame legs visible under the table in photo 3, consistent with a manual treadle-powered machine, not electric.
No photo shows the machine threaded, running, or stitching a sample of fabric.
No photo shows the underside mechanism, belt, or bobbin area in detail.
Watermarks 'FAVOUR AJOKU' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlay the images; these are marketplace watermarks, not item markings.

claims.claim: Used sewing machine still in very good condition
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show rust spots on the metal bed plate near the needle, and the wood table edges show visible wear, which is inconsistent with 'very good condition'.

risks.risk: Mechanical function unknown (hand wheel turn, needle movement, treadle action) since no demo video or stitching sample is shown.
risks.proof: A short video of the treadle being pedaled and the needle moving, plus a stitched fabric sample.

risks.risk: Rust visible on bed plate may extend to internal gears/shaft causing seizure.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the underside mechanism and hand-turned wheel rotation.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged accessories (bobbin, bobbin case, needle, belt) not shown in any photo.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the bobbin area and a spare needle/belt if included.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, accessories excluded

risks.risk: Wood cabinet/table integrity (woodworm, cracks, loose joints) given visible wear at edges.
risks.proof: Photo of the underside of the table and the treadle iron frame joints.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic wear with possible structural weakness

risks.risk: Unclear second badge/plate near needle plate (photo 2, 3) could indicate a different or modified part, affecting authenticity of brand.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of that plate/badge.
risks.if_unproven: treated as unverified branding, does not raise price

proof_requests: A video of the treadle being pedaled with the needle moving and a few stitches being made on fabric.
A close-up photo of the underside mechanism, gears, and hand wheel connection showing no seizure or missing parts.
A clear photo of the bobbin case, bobbin, and needle currently installed.
A photo of the underside of the wooden table and treadle iron frame for structural condition.
A clear, well-lit close-up of the small plate near the needle (seen in photos 2 and 3) to confirm what it reads.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a manual treadle sewing machine branded AMRO BROTHER, but visible rust and the seller's unproven 'very good condition' claim mean it must be priced at worst case as non-functional until a working demo is provided.
